policy: The CLI consumes the specification; it does not define it. The vendored file is a byte-for-byte copy of the canonical v1.0 schema and is never edited in this repository. Agent Manifest v1.0 is frozen, so any difference between this checksum and the canonical source is drift and is treated as an incident: the CLI is not re-vendored until the divergence is explained upstream. A future schema version is vendored as an additional file under a new CLI minor version, never by mutating this one.
